description.value:
Cursed Circuitry — Innate Technique (6th level)

Starting at 6th level, you can now apply a high performing Circuit to yourself or an object you touch as a bonus action for 2 CE or a willing creature you touch for 5 CE. Your circuit now lasts for 1 hour or 10 minutes if applied to another creature.
Improved Efficiency. The base cost of a feature that requires cursed energy other than Cursed Circuitry features decreases by 3 (min cost of 1). If a feature’s effects depend on how much cursed energy you spend, 1 CE you spend counts as 3 CE (Eg. Spending 2 CE on Cursed Strike counts as 6 CE). This cannot cause the effective cursed energy to be higher than a feature’s output limit.
Increased Output. When a feature allows you to spend additional cursed energy to strengthen the effects, you can spend additional cursed energy up to your proficiency bonus.
Enhancement. If you apply your circuit onto an Object or Cursed Tool, it instead gains two of the following benefits of your choice:

  • The item deals an additional 2d6 necrotic damage on a hit, increasing to 2d10 at 11th level.

  • The item grants a +3 bonus to AC, increasing to +5 at 11th level.

  • The cursed energy cost of the tool decreases by 2 (min of 1). This instead decreases cost by 4 at 11th level.

effects.name: High Performance Circuit (toggle)
effects.description: Conditional bonus: enable this effect while its condition applies.
